    CHAPTER I

The night was cold and the wind came off the water in long gusts.
He drew his coat about him and walked faster along the empty quay.

Between them lies a paragraph that is not repeated anywhere else.

The night was cold and the wind came off the water in long gusts.
He drew his coat about him and walked faster along the empty quay.

A single line may repeat once without being reported at all here.

Some quite different text separates the two single repetitions.

A single line may repeat once without being reported at all here.
